list: eval/businesses-5.json: 12 businesses never measured before, mixed input (2 name + domain, 2 name + city, 8 bare names), after the round-8 to round-11 fixes.
checkedBy: Independent re-check on 2026-10-14: curl (page bodies, titles, sizes), openssl s_client (certificate end dates), dig on name-built domains, Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) name search limited to Turkey; sites probed before the run while the list was built.

morn.not_on_map: right (no OSM match in Turkey; the Edinburgh 'Mørn Coffee' was correctly not taken)

kivircik.site_unreachable: right (the typed domain answers HTTP 404: Wix 'ConnectYourDomain Error', no site connected)
kivircik.https_healthy: WRONG (misleading): the certificate and redirect exist, but they serve a 404 page; the owner was told 'your site is secure and works over HTTPS' about a site that does not exist

gorkito.not_on_map: right (no OSM match in Turkey; it is on Yandex Maps only)

bubble.no_own_website: right (Shopier, Instagram and Şikayetvar only; butikbubble.com has no DNS)

begon.not_on_map: right (only a village 'Begon 2' in Chad, correctly not taken)

bebetto.site_online: WRONG: bebetto.com.tr answers 200 with an empty body (0 bytes); the brand's working site is bebetto.com
bebetto.https_healthy: unverifiable: the certificate and redirect on bebetto.com.tr are real, but nothing shows whether that empty address is the brand's
bebetto.no_contact_path: WRONG: true only of an empty page; bebetto.com, the real site, was never checked

ebru.no_own_website: right (ebruelbise.com/.com.tr have no DNS; Shopier store)

parla.no_own_website: right (parlakozmetik.com/.com.tr have no DNS; Shopier, Hepsiburada, Instagram)

styleme.site_online: WRONG: stylemeshop.com is a 114-byte script that sends visitors to a '/lander' parking page; nothing ties it to the Shopier shop
styleme.ssl_expiring_soon: WRONG: about a parked domain nothing ties to the business
styleme.phone_unconfirmed: WRONG: +1 843 663 1500 belongs to 'Style Me Boutique' in South Carolina, a namesake
styleme.on_map: WRONG: the planner guessed the city 'North Myrtle Beach' and the map matched 'Style Me Boutique' there, a US namesake

mk.site_online: WRONG: mkcollection.com is a US fabrics and wallcoverings company, a namesake found by the name-built guess
mk.on_map: WRONG: 'MK collection' in Dnipro, Ukraine, a namesake

gorkito.no_own_website: deserved to be dropped (gorkito.com is its own site); a true finding lost: the page does not name İstanbul, so the site stayed 'not settled'

causes: A page with no title and no text (0 bytes, or a script that jumps to a parking page) counted as 'real content'
With a bare name, an address that spells the whole name was taken as the business's site with nothing tying it to Turkey (mkcollection.com, stylemeshop.com)
A map match under a city the planner guessed, or anywhere abroad for a bare name, counted as 'listed on the map'
https_healthy could be kept for a site that does not load
